newsitem.title: NIGERIA: World Bank criticises Nigerian use of credit funds.
newsitem.headline: World Bank criticises Nigerian use of credit funds.

text.p: A World Bank representative on Thursday criticised Nigeria's handling of $17 million from a $120 million credit granted to improve primary education.

"The performance in the utilisation of this fund in the improvement of primary education has been largely characterised by low implementation and poor accounting," World Bank representative Trevor Byer told a news conference in the capital Abuja.
The credit was offered in 1991 to pay for school books, furniture and improved teacher training.
But Byer said the Bank had responded to an appeal from the Finance Ministry not to close the credit facility.
He said the decision to extend the facility, due for closure on June 30, was based on the condition that the project was implemented within two years under close monitoring.
